answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock $100 for 30 days before bidding on work, even a sonnet commission. An attacker can forge thousands of personas, but each needs a separate funded bond: 10,000 identities immobilize $1 million. Splitting money among wallets cannot multiply bidding access without multiplying locked capital. Even when borrowing rates reach their nadir, the attacker must finance that capital for the full lock period.
